name: Jet Admin
title: jetadmin.io
shortDescription: Jet Admin enables users to build custom web applications without coding, utilizing AI for rapid development. It's designed for developers and non-technical users alike, facilitating data integration from various sources like SQL databases and APIs. Example use cases include creating customer portals, inventory trackers, and custom CRMs.
cons: May require learning curve for non-tech users
Limited customization compared to coded solutions
